## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) notices [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dressed up and driving away from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), sparking her curiosity. She visits [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate and learns that the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) are adopting an orphan boy from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). Mrs. Rachel voices strong disapproval and warnings about the risks of adoption before taking her leave.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised
